name: Olympiaworld Innsbruck
kurzbeschreibung: Olympiaworld Innsbruck: Legendary sports and entertainment arena host of two Winter Olympic Games, featuring premier ice rinks and the Tivoli stadium.
beschreibung:
Overview

The iconic Olympiaworld Innsbruck is western Austria's foremost venue for major sports, concerts, and cultural entertainment, located in the Pradl district in southern Innsbruck at an elevation of approximately 580 metres. Having proudly hosted the Winter Olympic Games in 1964 and 1976 as well as the inaugural Winter Youth Olympic Games in 2012, the expansive complex occupies a revered place in global sporting heritage. Its architectural nucleus is the renowned Olympiahalle, joined by the state-of-the-art TIWAG Arena, the outdoor 400-metre ice oval, the Tivoli football stadium, and extensive athletic grounds.

Olympic Heritage & Public Skating

Constructed in 1963 and modernized extensively in 2004, the multi-purpose Olympiahalle accommodates up to 10,000 spectators for world championships, ice hockey encounters, Davis Cup tennis ties, and arena concerts by global music stars. For visitors and locals alike, Olympiaworld is a bustling recreational hub: during the winter months (October through March), regular public skating sessions across the indoor sheets of the TIWAG Arena and the 400-metre outdoor speed-skating track invite ice skaters of all skill levels. Next door, the Tivoli Stadium hosts home matches for traditional football teams and the European champion Swarco Raiders Tirol American football squad before crowds of up to 16,000. Further athletic amenities include a modern bouldering gym, squash and padel courts, and skate parks.

Visit & Getting There

Olympiaworld is open during scheduled sports tournaments, shows, and regular public ice-skating hours. Public skating (October to March): open daily during scheduled morning and afternoon sessions; Saturday evenings feature a vibrant Ice Disco with DJ music and light shows. Public skating admission (2025/2026 season): adults approx. €6.50, children/youth approx. €4.00, skate rental on site approx. €5.00. Event tickets vary by promoter. Address: Olympiastraße 10, 6020 Innsbruck. Arriving by car: take the Inntalautobahn A12 to the Innsbruck-Mitte exit, following signs to Olympiaworld / Tivoli (large multistorey car park on site). By public transport: take IVB bus lines J, S, or T directly from Innsbruck Hauptbahnhof to the Olympiaworld stop.

Tips

The entire arena facility is barrier-free with ramps, elevators, and designated wheelchair spectator seating. The Saturday evening Ice Disco is immensely popular with teenagers and families. Convenient skate sharpening and hire services are located directly inside the entrance foyer.
